## Screen Dump Utilities (CGSDUMP/BWSDUMP)

Two related utilities capture the active graphics buffer to a printer or file: `CGSDUMP` (color) and `BWSDUMP` (monochrome). Both need an active graphics mode with an allocated display buffer - dumping with no graphics mode active and no picture file given fails with error 246 (device not ready). Both support `-s <path>` to redirect the dump to a disk file instead of a printer. Vertical resolution is fixed at 192 pixels in every mode; `CGSDUMP`'s horizontal resolution is 128 pixels for most color options, with a subset of its ten color/option presets (indexed 0-9) extending to 256 pixels wide. `BWSDUMP` adds an inverse mode (`-i`, swaps black/
